citations.quote: must not be reference-modified, subscripted, or qualified unless specifically permitted by the rules of the format
citations.check: OK  §1985:III.2 p69  (2. <u>DEFINITIONS</u>)  the text is in p69

citations.quote: Data-name-1 and data-name-2 may be qualified
citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR2  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

citations.quote: Data-name-2 must not be qualified even if it is not unique
citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR7  (5.10.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7

cases.reason: The 1985 text: "'data-name' represents a word which must not be reference-modified, subscripted, or qualified unless specifically permitted by the rules of the format."
